x: Necks were craned to watch the runners approach 15 miles in the hope that Len had established third place, but unfortunately he had not had a good time this lap for Hopcroft and Shave had well and truly dropped him, whilst Elderfield (TVH) had also moved ahead by some 23 secs.
Three weeks later he was 3rd, behind Mekler(Sth.Africa) and Elderfield (TVH), in the London-Brighton Run, covering the 53miles-129yds in 5:36:14. ---an average of 9.48miles per hour.
Despite the bad conditions his time was a new Club record. His long distance rival, Elderfield of TVH, was left trailing by almost a minute.
